Alouette Blue Cheese Salad Dressing
By: Corrinne
Published: Tuesday, September 7, 2010 - 1:35pm

Ingredients




1 cup mayonnaise
1/2 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
1/2 teaspoon lemon juice
1/2 cup Alouette Cuisine Creme Fraiche
1 package (4 oz) Alouette Crumbled Blue Cheese
Salt and pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Combine mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice and Alouette Cuisine Creme Fraiche in a bowl and whisk well . 2 Add Alouette Crumbled Blue Cheese and mix well 3 Serve immediately on your favorite salad greens or keep refrigerated for up to 3 days.
